business_summary.text: Sigma Advanced Systems is a globally integrated aerospace and defence company with manufacturing operations in India and the UK, supplying high-precision components to global aerospace OEMs.

call_points.text: Sri City transfer-of-work facility reached operational readiness, commencement in the third quarter.
Non-destructive testing at Sri City goes live in Q4FY27.
Pipeline has multiple active bids across aerospace and defence, with contract durations up to 10 years.
Capex and working capital deployed into UK facilities, expected to unlock further efficiencies.
No numeric FY27 revenue, margin or capex guidance is given; the deck is qualitative on growth levers.
A greenfield Sri City facility of 23 acres with a 2.5 lakh sq. ft. master plan is described as coming up, with no date.
Delegatory approvals are said to cut the work-transfer approval timeframe to 4-6 months, a 70%+ reduction.

operating_notes.text: Acquired 51% of AS Strategic Private Limited (formerly Megasoft Limited), Delhi, on April 21, 2026; deal value not disclosed.
Secured £300 million (₹3,800 Cr) seven-year agreement with Rolls-Royce for aerospace systems manufacturing
Secured USD 11.4 Mn (₹107 Cr) export order for 90,000 units of filled fuzes for 155 mm artillery shells to be executed over ten months
Acquired 100% stake in Nasmyth Group, UK via Sigma Advanced Systems UK Limited, consolidated from November 1, 2025.
Divested entire stake in Extrovis AG during FY26.
Board approved preferential issue of 1.32 crore shares at ₹347 each raising ₹460 Cr and acquisition of additional 25% stake in AS Strategic Private Limited via 4.32 lakh shares.
Awarded a USD 21.97 million (₹208 Cr) export contract for 40,000 units of 155 mm M107 artillery shell bodies to be executed over six months.
Order book split is 90% defence and 10% commercial; revenue split is 85% international and 15% India.
Long-term contracts run up to 8 years; delegatory approvals are said to cut work-transfer approval to 4-6 months.
AS Strategic (51%) brings 8 active teaming agreements with global OEMs and three European JVs (AbraWorks, Escrabano, Arquimea).
Order book of INR 8,000 Cr+ with ~7 years of visibility; aerospace contracts run 5-7 years, defence export 1.5-2 years.
Typical EBITDA margins: aerospace 10-14%, defence export 22-28%, defence domestic 25-30%.
Revenue split 80-85% international and 15-20% India; 800+ skilled employees across ~350k sq ft.
Signed an exclusive MoU with Munitions India Limited for 155 mm artillery course-correction fuzes integration and manufacturing.
Secured US$19.7 million (~₹174 Cr) order from North American NATO customer for 155 mm artillery ammunition subsystems to be executed by Q2 2027.
Secured an order valued at USD 102.23 million (approx. INR 973 Cr) for the manufacture and supply of Base Bleed (BB) Units for a NATO customer to be executed over 12 months.

timeline.summary: 2026-04-21: Sigma Advanced Systems completed the acquisition of a 51% stake in AS Strategic Private Limited (formerly Megasoft Limited), Delhi, after conditions precedent were met.
2026-04-27: Sigma Advanced Systems secures £300 million (₹3,800 Cr) seven-year agreement with Rolls-Royce to manufacture and supply aerospace systems
2026-05-14: Sigma Advanced Systems secures USD 11.4 Mn (₹107 Cr) export order for artillery fuzes from North American customer
Ramanagaram Enterprises Private Limited, promoter of Sigma Advanced Systems Limited, declared no encumbrance on its shares for FY2026 on 1st April 2026.
Hillpark Event Management LLP, part of Sigma Advanced Systems Limited’s promoter group, declared no encumbrance on its shares during FY2026 ended March 31, 2026.
2026-06-04: Sigma Advanced Systems approves ₹460 Cr preferential equity issue to non-promoters and a ₹15 Cr share-swap acquisition to raise its stake in AS Strategic to 76%.
Sigma Advanced Systems secured a ₹208 Cr export contract for 40,000 units of 155 mm M107 artillery shell bodies from a North American customer.

2026-06-23: Sigma Advanced Systems issued a corporate presentation recapping Q4FY26 revenue of ₹323 Cr and PBT of ₹130 Cr, with a 90% defence order book and a greenfield Sri City plant still coming up.

2026-08-17: Sigma Advanced Systems' investor presentation put its order book at INR 8,000 Cr+ with ~7 years of visibility, guided 2-4% EBITDA improvement by end-FY27, and reported Q1FY27 revenue of ₹374 Cr and PAT of ₹38 Cr.
2026-10-14: Sigma Advanced Systems signed an exclusive MoU with Munitions India Limited to localise and manufacture 155 mm artillery course-correction fuzes.
On October 21, 2026, Sigma Advanced Systems secured a US$19.7 million (approx. ₹174 crore) order from a North American NATO customer for 155 mm artillery ammunition subsystems.
Sigma Advanced Systems secured a ₹973 Cr order from a NATO customer for Base Bleed Units of 155mm artillery ammunition.
